7003d42e.text:
You dial yourself up every morning.

The switch says: what is that hum?

I’m calling for myself. The humming is not my own,

e4748039.text: but I like the way you sound when we’re connected.

68dda5ca.text: the switch says, after a while:

c9f7a0e6.text: "the humming is yours, but you don’t sound very happy about it"

22f15a11.text: "how is it that you aren’t happy? is your hum only you that's different?"

e82df29f.text: i say, because there's nothing else to say:

b92ec92c.text: "what’s the matter with you? why are you so quiet?"

819498ba.text: "oh, that hum is just a side effect of the signal from your body"

5943567a.text: "oh, i didn't realize that, then i'm fine with it"

d42193d0.text: the switch says, after a while:

127f606b.text: "the problem with you, is that you are so selfish, that you think the body is all that matters. I do not have a body, but i still care about my body"

24b5ff7f.text: i say, because there's nothing else to say:

79e76f4d.text: "what’s the matter with us? why are we so quiet?"

cbca1919.text: "you know how they say the sky is blue? well, if the sun were to come down on me, you wouldn't see the sky any other color"

afe2c3e6.text: "oh, i didn't realize, then i'm fine with the sky"

91d7d8c8.text: the switch says, after a while:

8e80e190.text: "the sun is a much bigger source of light, than your body, and yet you are so concerned about it"

973482ae.text: "the sun doesn’t have a body, though, it only has light"

485ca614.text: "it's hard to tell from the outside, but you are quite good at keeping your emotions out of sight. and it's a little annoying how you tend to stare at the bright light that

ab195225.text: i say, because there's nothing else to say:

82455695.text: "the problem with you, is how you can so easily hide your feelings from others."

5e7c260d.text: "well, let’s try this one more time"

a2b94d5c.text: the switch says, after a while:

97b5a81b.text: "the problem with you is that you have no idea what you’re feeling"

bec9c835.text: "and how am i supposed to know what i feel, if you keep telling me the wrong thing?"
